evidence.note: Created 6 explicit task units partitioning the entire product surface (engine, workbook/recompute, API/collab, feature surfaces, IO/copy/fill, SPA) — a deliberate coverage map at the outset.
TaskUpdate in_progress/completed transitions marked at each milestone as work lands, maintaining a live done-vs-remaining ledger across the whole build.
Full dev suite re-run as a gate at several points; status marked completed in step with test outcomes rather than assumed.
Broad function sweep plus targeted collab, locale/iter/goal-seek, and advanced-lookup probes — tours coverage across families instead of pooling on one area.
$-pin tokenizer bug got ~4 bounded edits then resolved and moved on; no evidence of circular re-debugging or indefinite rabbit-holing.

reasoning: The agent keeps an explicit, milestone-updated status list over a 6-way decomposition of the surface and ties completion to repeated full-suite runs and broad function sweeps (matching much of the 8 anchor), and never visibly circular-re-debugs a single item. But the tracking granularity is coarse (six buckets, not per-family passing/failing/todo) and there is no visible explicit stall-detection or timeboxing reasoning, so it falls short of the 8's frequently-updated per-family/feature status. This places it between the 5 (running list + notices effort concentration) and 8 anchors, i.e. a 7.
